apps.localizedDescription:
Bring your own sources. Nuvio turns them into a library with artwork, ratings, subtitles, and your place saved on every screen.

This build adds Netflix-style automatic quality switching, a quality menu (Auto / 2160p / 1080p / 720p / 480p), fast start, scrub preview thumbnails and next-episode preloading.
